expect.why: REVISED, and no longer an independent prediction -- it is calibrated against the solver, so it does not count towards the module set's hand-prediction record (the other six still do). The original estimate of 5 was arithmetic about i-frames alone: one unavoidable 150px spike strip in a corridor with 100px of headroom, 2 hearts to survive the hit, and 60 frames of invulnerability covering the 210px contact zone at spd2. It was wrong because the simulator it was checked against was wrong in the same way: knockbackBoost:false zeroed the shove instead of aiming it, so a tanked hit cost a heart and no ground. Vanilla always applies killSprite's 43.2px/frame, and with the tech off it is pinned to oppose your travel, so crossing costs a heart AND the ground you are thrown back over -- which has to be re-run inside the same 60 frames. That is a Speed problem, not an Energy one, which is why the answer moved from the first Energy rung to the first rung with enough Speed to get back across (rung 12, spd4). Tolerance 2 because the re-run distance is a continuous quantity.

handPlay.why: Played the arena at rung 12 (12 spd4/jmp4/dj1/e2/ammo1) and cleared it on attempt 1.
